compiled_state.description:
## Problem
The reconciler active-set query hardcodes status != "Done" as the only Done-equivalent
(fetcher.py jql_active / jql_done_recent). The code comment admits it: "A project whose
workflow adds another closed-equivalent status would need this to move to
statusCategory != \"Done\"". Against a live CLIENT Jira whose workflow uses Closed /
Resolved / Cancelled (common), issues in those statuses are NOT "Done", so:
- jql_active pulls Closed/Resolved issues into the active working set -> the reconciler
  treats resolved issues as active and may push outbound mutations at them.
- jql_done_recent misses them, so they never populate the recent-Done snapshot.
This mis-scopes the entire active set for any non-DIG/REB workflow.

## Approach
Switch the Done predicate from the literal status = "Done" to Jira's status CATEGORY:
statusCategory = Done / statusCategory != Done, which is workflow-agnostic (every Jira
status maps to one of To Do / In Progress / Done categories, including custom Closed/
Resolved/Cancelled statuses which map to the Done category). Keep the JQL builders'
per-project scoping and _validate_project_key unchanged. Verify ACLI/JQL supports
statusCategory (it does on both Cloud and DC).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] jql_active excludes any status in the Done statusCategory (not just literal "Done").
      Verified by `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_fetch_multi_project.py tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/fetch/ -q`.
- [x] jql_done_recent selects the Done statusCategory, ORDER BY updated DESC, cap preserved.
      Verified by the same test command.
- [x] Single-project + multi-project fan-out unchanged otherwise; DIG/REB (To Do/In Progress/
      Done only) behavior is identical. Verified by the same test command.

## Testing
- `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_fetch_multi_project.py tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/fetch/ tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_reconcile_once.py -q`
  — JQL-builder unit tests assert the statusCategory predicate on jql_active / jql_done_recent
  for single- and multi-project fan-out (no live Jira; JQL strings asserted directly).
  RED first: a test encoding a client workflow with a "Resolved" status shows the OLD
  `status != "Done"` query would include Resolved in the active set (bug), and the NEW
  `statusCategory != Done` query excludes it.
- `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_fetch_paging_split.py -q` — guards the
  650-line fetcher.py size target.
- `make lint` and `make typecheck` from the worktree.

## Sequencing
Edits fetcher.py jql builders AND tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_fetch_multi_project.py
(plus the fetch/ and orchestrate/ JQL-string tests), which ticket A also edits — this ticket
is SEQUENCED AFTER ticket A (a01d). Rebased onto A's landed change.
